entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Manvendra Singh,Saurabh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 3 of 2024 at Police Station- Bhuta, District- Bareilly under Sections 376, 354, 504, 506, 323, 325 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 29.01.2024.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 15.02.2024.

The following arguments made by Sri Manvendra Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Sri Chandan Agarwal, learned AGA-I from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Pramod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143866260/
1

entities.text: Pramod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1. The F.I.R. is the result of an altercation between the parties which escalated into violence.
2. Parties of the first informant were aggressors.
3. No allegation of commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has been made in the FIR.
4. False and aggravated allegations were subsequently made by the victim in her statements under Sections 161 and 164 CrPC at the behest of her parents to save the failing prosecution case.
5. Even as per the statements of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. the family members reached the spot when the victim raised a hue and cry.
6. Medical evidence to establish the commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.

7. Major inconsistencies in the statements of the victim under Sections 161 Cr.P.C.
and Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as the recitals in the F.I.R. discredit the prosecution case.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Pramod Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(iii) The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru.
Pramod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143866260/
2 Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
